f1.name: FIA Formula One World Championship
f1.race_distance_rule: Grand Prix = minimum 305 km, laps = fewest whole laps exceeding 305 km; Monaco exception 260 km (78 laps). 2027 ONLY: race distance reduced to 290 km at all races except Monaco (fuel-flow change; reverts to 305 km from 2028). 2-hour race limit kept; the 3-hour stoppage clock replaced by a hard stop time. Sprint race ~100 km (~30 min), no mandatory pit stop.

points.note: Fastest-lap bonus point abolished by the FIA from the 2025 season onwards; shortened races (<75% distance) pay reduced points.

format_2027.weekend_sprint: FP1 60 min Friday; Sprint Qualifying Friday (SQ1 12 min / SQ2 10 min / SQ3 8 min); Sprint Saturday morning; GP Qualifying Saturday afternoon; race Sunday
format_2027.quali: Q1 18 min / Q2 15 min / Q3 13 min; 6 slowest eliminated after Q1 and after Q2 (22-car grid, 11 teams), top 10 shootout in Q3
format_2027.tyres: Pirelli sole supplier (contract through 2027); 3 dry compounds chosen per weekend, two different compounds mandatory in a dry race
format_2027.power_unit_2027: ICE 420 kW + MGU-K 300 kW (58:42 split, changing to 60:40 in 2028); harvesting 375 kW; fuel flow +5%; gearbox homologation scrapped; pre-season testing 4 days

f1.status_2027: confirmed — 24-GP calendar with 10 Sprint weekends announced 16 Sep 2026 (formula1.com); 290 km distance ratified by WMSC 21 Sep / 23 Jun 2026

motogp.name: FIM MotoGP World Championship
motogp.race_distance_rule: No fixed km: GP race distance is set in laps per circuit by Dorna (typically ~100-120 km); Sprint race ~half GP distance. 2027: fuel tank 20 L (11 L for Sprint).

format_2027.weekend: NEW from 2027: Sprint Qualifying on Friday, FP3 + GP qualifying Saturday, Moto3/Moto2 races Sunday before the MotoGP GP; Sprint and GP have separate grids
format_2027.rules_2027: 850cc engines (bore 75 mm, 6 engines/rider/season); ride-height devices banned; 100% sustainable fuel; wildcards banned; all manufacturers start in concession Rank B; Pirelli sole tyre supplier 2027-2031 (replacing Michelin)

motogp.status_2027: confirmed — 2027 calendar revealed 25 Sep 2026; new weekend format announced 7 Oct 2026 (motogp.com)

wec.name: FIA World Endurance Championship
wec.race_distance_rule: Races run to a set time or distance: 6 h (Imola, Silverstone, Spa, Sao Paulo, COTA, Fuji), Qatar 1812 km (distance), 8 h Bahrain, 24 h Le Mans. Points scale with duration (see points).

format_2027.announced: calendar announced 12 Jun 2026 during the 2026 Le Mans weekend

categories: Hypercar (LMH/LMDh) — Hypercar World Endurance Drivers' & Manufacturers' Championships
LMGT3 — FIA Endurance Trophy for Drivers and Teams
wec.status_2027: confirmed (calendar announced); LMP2 no longer a full-season WEC class since 2024

imsa.name: IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship
imsa.race_distance_rule: Timed races: Rolex 24 at Daytona (24 h), 12 Hours of Sebring, Petit Le Mans (10 h), 6 Hours of Watkins Glen, 2 h 40 min endurance races, 100 min (1 h 40) sprint/street races. Points also awarded at intervals in endurance races (6 h: at 3 h and finish; Sebring every 4 h; Daytona every 6 h; Petit Le Mans at 4/8/10 h).

points.note: winner 35 pts, then descending; endurance races pay at intervals plus finish

format_2027.endurance_cup: Michelin Endurance Cup = the 5 long races (Daytona 24 h, Sebring 12 h, Watkins Glen 6 h, Road America/Mosport 6 h class-dependent, Petit Le Mans 10 h)

indycar.name: IndyCar Series (NTT IndyCar Series)
indycar.race_distance_rule: Races set by distance in miles: Indianapolis 500 = 500 miles / 200 laps; other ovals typically 200-300 miles; road/street courses set lap counts (~1.5-2 h).

points.note: Indy 500 pays single points since 2023; -10 pts for entrant-initiated engine change before distance mandate

format_2027.changes_2027: non-chartered entries restricted to the Indianapolis 500 only (rule announced 28 Apr 2026); new Dallara IR-27 chassis debuts; Milwaukee double-header

nascar.name: NASCAR Cup Series
nascar.race_distance_rule: Races set in laps/miles: Daytona 500 = 500 mi (200 laps); Coca-Cola 600 = 600 mi (400 laps, 4 stages); most other Cup races 250-400 mi (e.g. 400, 350, 301, 300, 250). Divided into 3 stages (4 for the 600): stage 1 ~1/4, stage 2 ~1/4, final stage ~1/2 of distance.

points.stage_note: top 10 at end of stages 1 and 2; final stage pays only race points
points.playoff_note: top 10 in playoff races earn playoff points in addition; 16-driver playoff after 26 regular-season races

format_2027.changes_2027: 750 hp package at all intermediate tracks from the Coca-Cola 600; single-round qualifying at Daytona/Atlanta/Talladega superspeedways; Richmond, Watkins Glen and New Hampshire return to the playoff; Dodge returns as a manufacturer (Kaulig Racing)

wrc.name: FIA World Rally Championship
wrc.race_distance_rule: Rallies are set by special stages: target ~300+ km of competitive (special stage) distance per event (2027 opening rounds listed at 353.57 km and 307.08 km); final stage is the Power Stage.

format_2027.regulations: new WRC27 Rally1 technical regulations replace the 2022-2026 rules; Manufacturers' championship renamed 'World Rally Championship for Constructors'; new 'World Rally Championship for Teams' title for privateer Rally1 entries; Rally GB (Scotland) returns in 2027

wsbk.name: FIM Superbike World Championship (WorldSBK)
wsbk.race_distance_rule: Each round: Race 1 and Race 2 full-length races of 90-110 km (laps set per circuit), plus a 10-lap Superpole Race that sets the Race 1 grid.

format_2027.weekend: 3 races per round: Superpole Race (10 laps, Sat), Race 1 (Sun), Race 2 (Sun); Race 2 grid partly reversed from Race 1
format_2027.rules_2027: Michelin becomes sole tyre supplier from 2027 (5-year deal, replacing Pirelli after 2026); SBK Commission roadmap 2027-2030: rev-limit/concession changes from 2027, 1200 cc engines planned for 2030; provisional 2027 calendar revealed 1 Oct 2026 (China debut, Valencia return)

wsbk.status_2027: expected — provisional 2027 calendar announced; no 2027 season article yet, 2026 rules carried forward

fe.name: ABB FIA Formula E World Championship
fe.race_distance_rule: E-Prix set in laps per circuit (distance varies ~80-110 km by venue); +1 lap added per 4 minutes under full-course yellow/safety car. From 2026-27, the first race of a double-header ('E-Prix Unleashed') is a 30-minute sprint without pit stops.

points.note: pole = winner of the final qualifying duel (4 pts + 1 pole pt = 5)

format_2027.season: Season 13 (2026-27) debuts the Gen4 car: max 600 kW, all-wheel drive active at all times, Bridgestone tyres; Attack Mode can be paused during FCY; amended qualifying-duel points

fe.status_2027: confirmed (Gen4 + format announced on fiaformulae.com / fia.com)

dtm.name: Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM)
dtm.race_distance_rule: Two races per weekend (Sat + Sun), each 55 minutes plus one complete lap; mandatory pit stop for a full set of fresh tyres in both races. GT3-spec cars.

format_2027.season: 41st season / 28th under DTM moniker, 7th GT3 season; 2027 calendar announced (dtm.com, Aug 2026: Alpine opener, city spectacle, North Sea action)

btcc.name: British Touring Car Championship (Kwik Fit BTCC)
btcc.race_distance_rule: Three races per meeting on Sunday, distances set in laps per circuit; 2027: a Qualifying Race ('Race to Pole') of ~half standard race distance sets the Race 1 grid. Race 2 grid from Race 1 finishing order; Race 3 grid by reverse-grid draw (2027: draw covers P10-16 of Race 2).

format_2027.saturday: two 25-min practice sessions; single 20-min one-group qualifying (2026's two-group format dropped)
format_2027.technical: NGTC-based rules; from 2027 any brand sold in the UK with an ICE as primary power source is eligible (btcc.net 2027 technical regulations)
format_2027.calendar: announced 18 Apr 2026; format changes agreed 9 Nov 2026 (btcc.net)

btcc.status_2027: confirmed (calendar 18 Apr 2026; format changes 9 Nov 2026, btcc.net)

elms.name: European Le Mans Series (ELMS)
elms.race_distance_rule: All races 4 hours (2027: six 4-hour rounds). Points 25-18-15-12-10-8-6-4-2-1 + 1 pole point.

format_2027.announced: calendar announced 3 Jul 2026; LMP2 split renamed: LMP2 Pro (no Bronze driver) vs LMP2 (with Bronze); Le Castellet drops the Mistral chicane again

asian-le-mans.name: Asian Le Mans Series (2026-27 'Winter Le Mans Series')

format_2027.season: 2026-27 season runs as an exceptional European winter calendar (Nov 2026 - Feb 2027): Paul Ricard, Jerez, Portimao, ... six 4-hour rounds
format_2027.classes: Hypercar (privateer LMH/LMDh, new premier class from 2026-27), LMP2 (Gibson GK428 V8, Michelin), LMP3, GT3 — Pro-Am categorisation

gtwce.name: GT World Challenge Europe (SRO Motorsports Group)
gtwce.race_distance_rule: Sprint Cup rounds: two 1-hour races each (15 sprint races in 2027). Endurance Cup: 3 h (Imola, Nurburgring, Barcelona), 6 h (Paul Ricard), 24 h Spa.

points.note: 24 Hours of Spa awards points on a longer scale with intermediate classifications (higher than the standard scale)

format_2027.titles: overall GT World Challenge Europe championship plus Sprint Cup and Endurance Cup titles
format_2027.classes: Pro, Gold, Silver, Bronze (Pro-Am only at the 24 Hours of Spa, ineligible for points)
format_2027.calendar: provisional calendar released 26 Jun 2026 at the Spa 24 h press conference; Imola replaces Monza, Hungaroring replaces Algarve in round 9

gtwca.name: GT World Challenge America (SRO Motorsports Group)
gtwca.race_distance_rule: Since 2026: a single 3-hour race per weekend (previously sprint format). 2027: 7 rounds.

format_2027.calendar: provisional calendar released 26 Jun 2026 (Sonoma, ...); Watkins Glen returns
format_2027.classes: GT3 cars; Pro / Pro-Am / Am categories

igtc.name: Intercontinental GT Challenge (SRO Motorsports Group)
igtc.race_distance_rule: Five endurance events by time/distance: Bathurst 12 Hour, Texas 8 Hour at COTA (new for 2027), Nurburgring 24 Hours, Spa 24 Hours, Suzuka 1000 km.

points.note: manufacturer points per event — up to 4 cars entered, best 2 score; Pro drivers' title also awarded

format_2027.calendar: announced 26 Jun 2026 at Spa 24 h press conference; Texas 8 Hour replaces the Indianapolis 8 Hour; Spa 24 also counts for Super GT GT300

nls.name: ADAC Nürburgring Langstrecken-Serie (NLS)
nls.race_distance_rule: One-day Saturday races on the Nordschleife + GP-Strecke combination: standard NLS races 4 hours (a single driver may run the whole 4 h), flagship Nürburgring 6 Hours with 2-4 drivers per car.

points.drivers: per class by finishing position, 15-1 points scale adjusted by number of starters in class; best 8 races count for the championship
points.qualifying_bonus: top 3 in qualifying score bonus points in team classifications

format_2027.note: 2027 calendar not yet published at access date; 2026 format carried forward (8 rounds incl. Nürburgring 6 h)

categories: SP9 / GT3 and other SP classes
nls.status_2027: expected — no 2027 Wikipedia season article; 2026 rules from nuerburgring-langstrecken-serie.de / Wikipedia 2026 NLS

h24eu.name: 24H European Series (Michelin 24H Series, Creventic)
h24eu.race_distance_rule: Races run to a set time: 12-hour or 24-hour events (e.g. 12H Mugello, 24H Barcelona, 24H Dubai).

format_2027.note: 2027 calendar not yet published at access date; 2026 (12th season) format carried forward — GT3/GT4/TC/TCE/CUP cars, per-class championships

categories: per-class championships (SP9/GT3, SP8, GT4, TCE, CUP/P)
h24eu.status_2027: expected — 24h-series.com blocked automated access; facts from Wikipedia 24H Series / 2026 24H Series

bgt.name: British GT Championship
bgt.race_distance_rule: Race weekend: Race 1 of 60/120/180 min depending on venue, plus a 60-min Race 2 at selected venues (Oulton Park, Snetterton); qualifying split into GT3/GT4 sessions.

format_2027.note: 2027 calendar not yet published at access date; 2026 format carried forward (britishgt.com/about/british-gt)

bgt.status_2027: expected — no 2027 season article; 2026 rules from britishgt.com / Wikipedia

sf.name: Super Formula Championship (Japan)
sf.race_distance_rule: Races set in laps per circuit (typically ~200-300 km, ~75-90 min; venue-dependent).

format_2027.calendar: provisional calendar announced 31 Jul 2026 by JAF (Suzuka opener, Suzuka finale 27-28 Nov)

sf.status_2027: expected — provisional calendar only (JAF, Jul 2026); points system unchanged since 2020
